### POST /runs/{runId}/test-plans

**Create the next version of a run plan**

Copies the non-removed cases of the newest version into a new draft. Requires Idempotency-Key: a retry returns the original version.

- Operation ID: `createTestPlanVersion`
- Authentication: `bearerAuth` or `sessionCookie`

| Parameter         | In     | Required | Type          | Description                                                                   |
| ----------------- | ------ | -------- | ------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `runId`           | path   | yes      | string (uuid) |                                                                               |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | yes      | string        | Makes a retry return the original result instead of a second write (API-008). |

#### Response 201

The new version.

| Header | Description                                                            |
| ------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `ETag` | Strong validator of this state. Send it back in If-Match to change it. |

Content type `application/json`: [TestPlanView](#testplanview).

Example: A draft version with one case.

```json
{
  "planId": "0198f0a0-0000-7000-8000-0000000000d1",
  "runId": "0198f0a0-0000-7000-8000-0000000000e1",
  "version": 2,
  "status": "draft",
  "etag": "\"8c2e7f4a10b9\"",
  "createdAt": "2026-10-01T10:00:00.000Z",
  "updatedAt": "2026-10-01T10:00:00.000Z",
  "cases": [
    {
      "caseId": "0198f0a0-0000-7000-8000-0000000000c1",
      "planId": "0198f0a0-0000-7000-8000-0000000000d1",
      "etag": "\"5b1d0c9a3e2f\"",
      "class": "passive",
      "title": "Login rate limit is enforced",
      "status": "proposed",
      "statusReason": null,
      "refs": {
        "owasp": ["A07"],
        "wstg": ["WSTG-ATHN-03"],
        "asvs": ["2.2.1"]
      },
      "cweCandidates": ["CWE-307"],
      "targets": ["https://app.example.test/login"],
      "roles": ["anonymous"],
      "budget": {
        "maxRequests": 50,
        "maxRps": 2,
        "maxConcurrency": 1,
        "maxBytes": 1048576
      },
      "oracle": {
        "type": "status_code",
        "params": {
          "expected": 429
        }
      },
      "negativeControl": {
        "kind": "known_safe_endpoint",
        "description": "Same login request with a valid, rate-compliant pause",
        "oracleMustNotFire": true,
        "params": {}
      },
      "createdAt": "2026-10-01T10:00:00.000Z",
      "updatedAt": "2026-10-01T10:00:00.000Z"
    }
  ]
}
```

Content type `application/problem+json`: [Problem](#problem).

### GET /runs/{runId}/test-plans/{version}

**Read one plan version with its cases**

- Operation ID: `getTestPlanVersion`
- Authentication: `bearerAuth` or `sessionCookie`

| Parameter | In   | Required | Type          | Description |
| --------- | ---- | -------- | ------------- | ----------- |
| `runId`   | path | yes      | string (uuid) |             |
| `version` | path | yes      | integer       |             |

#### Response 200

The version and its cases.

| Header | Description                                                            |
| ------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `ETag` | Strong validator of this state. Send it back in If-Match to change it. |

Content type `application/json`: [TestPlanView](#testplanview).

Example: A draft version with one case.

```json
{
  "planId": "0198f0a0-0000-7000-8000-0000000000d1",
  "runId": "0198f0a0-0000-7000-8000-0000000000e1",
  "version": 2,
  "status": "draft",
  "etag": "\"8c2e7f4a10b9\"",
  "createdAt": "2026-10-01T10:00:00.000Z",
  "updatedAt": "2026-10-01T10:00:00.000Z",
  "cases": [
    {
      "caseId": "0198f0a0-0000-7000-8000-0000000000c1",
      "planId": "0198f0a0-0000-7000-8000-0000000000d1",
      "etag": "\"5b1d0c9a3e2f\"",
      "class": "passive",
      "title": "Login rate limit is enforced",
      "status": "proposed",
      "statusReason": null,
      "refs": {
        "owasp": ["A07"],
        "wstg": ["WSTG-ATHN-03"],
        "asvs": ["2.2.1"]
      },
      "cweCandidates": ["CWE-307"],
      "targets": ["https://app.example.test/login"],
      "roles": ["anonymous"],
      "budget": {
        "maxRequests": 50,
        "maxRps": 2,
        "maxConcurrency": 1,
        "maxBytes": 1048576
      },
      "oracle": {
        "type": "status_code",
        "params": {
          "expected": 429
        }
      },
      "negativeControl": {
        "kind": "known_safe_endpoint",
        "description": "Same login request with a valid, rate-compliant pause",
        "oracleMustNotFire": true,
        "params": {}
      },
      "createdAt": "2026-10-01T10:00:00.000Z",
      "updatedAt": "2026-10-01T10:00:00.000Z"
    }
  ]
}
```

### GET /runs/{runId}/test-plans/{version}/diff

**Diff two versions of a run plan**

What changed from `against` to `version`: cases added, removed and modified, with the before and after of each changed field. Cases match by caseId, then by title and targets, so a re-created case is not reported as a removal plus an addition. The answer is deterministic and sorted by caseId, then title.

- Operation ID: `diffTestPlanVersions`
- Authentication: `bearerAuth` or `sessionCookie`

| Parameter | In    | Required | Type          | Description                                                        |
| --------- | ----- | -------- | ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `runId`   | path  | yes      | string (uuid) |                                                                    |
| `version` | path  | yes      | integer       | The version to diff to.                                            |
| `against` | query | yes      | integer       | The version to diff from. Any earlier or later version of the run. |

#### Response 200

The changes from `against` to `version`.

Content type `application/json`: [PlanDiff](#plandiff).

Example: One case re-titled and one added.

```json
{
  "fromVersion": 1,
  "toVersion": 2,
  "added": [
    {
      "caseId": "0198f0a0-0000-7000-8000-0000000000c1",
      "title": "Login rate limit is enforced"
    }
  ],
  "removed": [],
  "modified": [
    {
      "caseId": "0198f0a0-0000-7000-8000-0000000000c1",
      "title": "Login rate limit is enforced",
      "changes": [
        {
          "field": "status",
          "before": "proposed",
          "after": "approved"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

### POST /test-plans/{planId}/cases

**Add a test case to a draft plan version**

Requires If-Match (the plan ETag) and Idempotency-Key. An approved or superseded version answers 409 PLAN_VERSION_IMMUTABLE.

- Operation ID: `addTestCase`
- Authentication: `bearerAuth` or `sessionCookie`

| Parameter         | In     | Required | Type          | Description                                                                              |
| ----------------- | ------ | -------- | ------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `planId`          | path   | yes      | string (uuid) |                                                                                          |
| `If-Match`        | header | yes      | string        | The ETag from the last read. A stale value answers 412 ETAG_MISMATCH, a missing one 428. |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | yes      | string        | Makes a retry return the original result instead of a second write (API-008).            |

**Request body** (required)

Content type `application/json`: [TestCaseCreate](#testcasecreate).

Example: A passive check.

```json
{
  "caseId": "0198f0a0-0000-7000-8000-0000000000c1",
  "planId": "0198f0a0-0000-7000-8000-0000000000d1",
  "etag": "\"5b1d0c9a3e2f\"",
  "class": "passive",
  "title": "Login rate limit is enforced",
  "status": "proposed",
  "statusReason": null,
  "refs": {
    "owasp": ["A07"],
    "wstg": ["WSTG-ATHN-03"],
    "asvs": ["2.2.1"]
  },
  "cweCandidates": ["CWE-307"],
  "targets": ["https://app.example.test/login"],
  "roles": ["anonymous"],
  "budget": {
    "maxRequests": 50,
    "maxRps": 2,
    "maxConcurrency": 1,
    "maxBytes": 1048576
  },
  "oracle": {
    "type": "status_code",
    "params": {
      "expected": 429
    }
  },
  "negativeControl": {
    "kind": "known_safe_endpoint",
    "description": "Same login request with a valid, rate-compliant pause",
    "oracleMustNotFire": true,
    "params": {}
  },
  "createdAt": "2026-10-01T10:00:00.000Z",
  "updatedAt": "2026-10-01T10:00:00.000Z"
}
```

#### Response 201

The new case and its ETag.

| Header | Description                                                            |
| ------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `ETag` | Strong validator of this state. Send it back in If-Match to change it. |

Content type `application/json`: [TestCaseView](#testcaseview).

### GET /test-plans/{planId}/validation

**Validate a plan version against its standing authorisation**

Checks every case against the run standing authorisation (class ceiling, pre-approved classes, scope, roles, oracle, negative control and budgets), the Cedar plan policy and the run budget. ok is true only when violations is empty. Writes one test_plan.validated audit event.

- Operation ID: `validateTestPlan`
- Authentication: `bearerAuth` or `sessionCookie`

| Parameter | In   | Required | Type          | Description |
| --------- | ---- | -------- | ------------- | ----------- |
| `planId`  | path | yes      | string (uuid) |             |

#### Response 200

The validation result, with every violation.

Content type `application/json`: [PlanValidationResult](#planvalidationresult).

Example: A valid plan.

```json
{
  "planId": "0196f5c2-7a1e-7c3a-9b1d-2f4e6a8b0c11",
  "runId": "0196f5c2-7a1e-7c3a-9b1d-2f4e6a8b0c10",
  "version": 1,
  "saId": "0196f5c2-7a1e-7c3a-9b1d-2f4e6a8b0c20",
  "ok": true,
  "gate1Required": true,
  "violations": [],
  "budgetTotals": {
    "totalRequests": 50,
    "totalBytes": 1000000,
    "perClassCounts": {
      "passive": 0,
      "active_safe": 1,
      "state_changing": 0,
      "destructive": 0
    }
  },
  "validatedAt": "2026-10-30T00:00:00.000Z"
}
```

### DELETE /test-cases/{caseId}

**Remove a test case from a draft plan version**

Soft-removes the case (status removed). Removing an already removed case answers 200 and writes nothing. Otherwise requires If-Match.

- Operation ID: `removeTestCase`
- Authentication: `bearerAuth` or `sessionCookie`

| Parameter  | In     | Required | Type          | Description                                                                              |
| ---------- | ------ | -------- | ------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `caseId`   | path   | yes      | string (uuid) |                                                                                          |
| `If-Match` | header | no       | string        | The ETag from the last read. A stale value answers 412 ETAG_MISMATCH, a missing one 428. |

#### Response 200

The removed case.

| Header | Description                                                            |
| ------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `ETag` | Strong validator of this state. Send it back in If-Match to change it. |

Content type `application/json`: [TestCaseView](#testcaseview).

Example: A proposed case.

```json
{
  "caseId": "0198f0a0-0000-7000-8000-0000000000c1",
  "planId": "0198f0a0-0000-7000-8000-0000000000d1",
  "etag": "\"5b1d0c9a3e2f\"",
  "class": "passive",
  "title": "Login rate limit is enforced",
  "status": "proposed",
  "statusReason": null,
  "refs": {
    "owasp": ["A07"],
    "wstg": ["WSTG-ATHN-03"],
    "asvs": ["2.2.1"]
  },
  "cweCandidates": ["CWE-307"],
  "targets": ["https://app.example.test/login"],
  "roles": ["anonymous"],
  "budget": {
    "maxRequests": 50,
    "maxRps": 2,
    "maxConcurrency": 1,
    "maxBytes": 1048576
  },
  "oracle": {
    "type": "status_code",
    "params": {
      "expected": 429
    }
  },
  "negativeControl": {
    "kind": "known_safe_endpoint",
    "description": "Same login request with a valid, rate-compliant pause",
    "oracleMustNotFire": true,
    "params": {}
  },
  "createdAt": "2026-10-01T10:00:00.000Z",
  "updatedAt": "2026-10-01T10:00:00.000Z"
}
```

### PATCH /test-cases/{caseId}

**Edit a test case of a draft plan version**

Requires If-Match (the case ETag). Only the sent fields change.

- Operation ID: `updateTestCase`
- Authentication: `bearerAuth` or `sessionCookie`

| Parameter  | In     | Required | Type          | Description                                                                              |
| ---------- | ------ | -------- | ------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `caseId`   | path   | yes      | string (uuid) |                                                                                          |
| `If-Match` | header | yes      | string        | The ETag from the last read. A stale value answers 412 ETAG_MISMATCH, a missing one 428. |

**Request body** (required)

Content type `application/json`: [TestCasePatch](#testcasepatch).

Example: Retitle.

```json
{
  "title": "Login rate limit is enforced"
}
```

#### Response 200

The case after the change.

| Header | Description                                                            |
| ------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `ETag` | Strong validator of this state. Send it back in If-Match to change it. |

## findings

Findings: list and detail, tenant-scoped and read-only. Suspected findings are visible to analysts only (F17).

### GET /findings

**List the findings of the tenant, newest first**

Needs finding:read. Filters combine with AND. An unknown filter, a CWE or OWASP id outside the pinned lists, or a malformed limit is 400. Suspected findings are excluded unless the caller is an analyst. The page size is clamped to 200.

- Operation ID: `listFindings`
- Authentication: `bearerAuth` or `sessionCookie`

| Parameter        | In    | Required | Type                                                        | Description |
| ---------------- | ----- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- | ----------- |
| `assetId`        | query | no       | string (uuid)                                               |             |
| `status`         | query | no       | string                                                      |             |
| `severity`       | query | no       | enum: `"none"`, `"low"`, `"medium"`, `"high"`, `"critical"` |             |
| `cwe`            | query | no       | string                                                      |             |
| `owasp`          | query | no       | string                                                      |             |
| `baselineStatus` | query | no       | string                                                      |             |
| `cursor`         | query | no       | string                                                      |             |
| `limit`          | query | no       | integer                                                     |             |

#### Response 200

A page of findings.

Content type `application/json`: [FindingList](#findinglist).

Example: One finding.

```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "fnd_01m64cavacexhrddgjb6xd80xv",
      "title": "Missing authorisation on /admin",
      "class": "broken_access_control",
      "status": "confirmed",
      "baselineStatus": "new",
      "severity": null,
      "cweId": "CWE-285",
      "owaspCategory": "A01",
      "unmapped": false,
      "confidence": 0.9,
      "assetId": "0198f0a0-0000-7000-8000-0000000000e1",
      "location": {
        "method": "GET",
        "urlTemplate": "/admin",
        "parameter": null,
        "file": null,
        "line": null
      },
      "firstSeenRunId": "0198f0a0-0000-7000-8000-0000000000c1",
      "lastSeenRunId": "0198f0a0-0000-7000-8000-0000000000c1",
      "stateVersion": 1,
      "createdAt": "2026-10-29T10:00:00.000Z",
      "updatedAt": "2026-10-29T10:05:00.000Z"
    }
  ],
  "nextCursor": null,
  "hasMore": false
}
```

#### Response 400

A malformed cursor (invalid_cursor), limit (bad_request) or filter (invalid_filter).

Content type `application/problem+json`: [Problem](#problem).

#### Response 401

No valid credential.

Content type `application/problem+json`: [Problem](#problem).

#### Response 403

The caller has no finding:read permission in this tenant.

Content type `application/problem+json`: [Problem](#problem).

#### Response 404

Problem details; code is one of NOT_FOUND, POLICY_VERSION_NOT_FOUND, PERSONA_NOT_DEFINED, PROMPT_NO_RELEASED_VERSION, RUN_NOT_FOUND, SECRET_NOT_FOUND, KEYCLOAK_NOT_FOUND, PLAN_NOT_FOUND, TEST_CASE_NOT_FOUND, CONNECTOR_NOT_FOUND.

Content type `application/problem+json`: [Problem](#problem).

Example: Resource not found.

```json
{
  "type": "https://errors.blackwing.dev/NOT_FOUND",
  "title": "Resource not found",
  "status": 404,
  "code": "NOT_FOUND",
  "traceId": "4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736"
}
```

```json
  "type": "https://errors.blackwing.dev/POLICY_VERSION_NOT_FOUND",
```

### GET /findings/{id}

**Get one finding with its occurrences, mapping and evidence refs**

Needs finding:read. Occurrences and evidence refs are each capped at 50 and carry total and truncated. Evidence is referenced by its chain head and resolved by the evidence API. A finding the caller may not see is 404.

- Operation ID: `getFinding`
- Authentication: `bearerAuth` or `sessionCookie`

| Parameter | In   | Required | Type   | Description                           |
| --------- | ---- | -------- | ------ | ------------------------------------- |
| `id`      | path | yes      | string | The `fnd_…` public id of the finding. |

#### Response 200

The finding detail.

Content type `application/json`: [Finding](#finding).

Example: A confirmed finding with one occurrence.

```json
{
  "id": "fnd_01m64cavacexhrddgjb6xd80xv",
  "title": "Missing authorisation on /admin",
  "class": "broken_access_control",
```

#### Response 401

No valid credential.

Content type `application/problem+json`: [Problem](#problem).

#### Response 403

The caller has no finding:read permission in this tenant.

Content type `application/problem+json`: [Problem](#problem).

#### Response 404

Unknown, foreign or hidden finding.

Content type `application/problem+json`: [Problem](#problem).

#### Response 409

Problem details; code is one of CONFLICT, ILLEGAL_RUN_TRANSITION, GATE1_NOT_PENDING, GATE1_PLAN_STALE, GATE1_EXPIRED, ENVELOPE_SA_EXPIRED, ENVELOPE_WINDOW_CLOSED, POLICY_ROLLBACK_TARGET_NOT_EARLIER, POLICY_NO_ACTIVE_VERSION, AUTHZ_ILLEGAL_TRANSITION, AUTHZ_NOT_DRAFT, KEK_DISABLED, DB_SERIALIZATION_CONFLICT, KILL_ALREADY_IN_PROGRESS, GATE2_NO_ELIGIBLE_APPROVER, RUN_NOT_ACTIVE, INVALID_TRANSITION, SECRET_NAME_CONFLICT, SECRET_IN_USE, SECRET_DISABLED, ASSET_STALE_WRITE, ASSET_IN_USE, QUOTA_EXCEEDED, ASSET_VERIFICATION_ILLEGAL_TRANSITION, ASSET_CRED_DUPLICATE_ROLE, CHANNEL_NAME_CONFLICT, CHANNEL_SECRET_UNAVAILABLE, CHANNEL_REFERENCED, KEYCLOAK_CONFLICT, FINDING_ILLEGAL_TRANSITION, TRIAGE_PRECONDITION_FAILED, TRIAGE_INVALID_TRANSITION, PLAN_VERSION_IMMUTABLE, GATE2_ILLEGAL_TRANSITION, GATE2_ALREADY_DECIDED.

Content type `application/problem+json`: [Problem](#problem).

```json
  "type": "https://errors.blackwing.dev/CONFLICT",
```

#### Response 422

Problem details; code is one of VALIDATION_FAILED, EVIDENCE_INTEGRITY_FAILED, GATE1_PLAN_INVALID, ENVELOPE_VERIFICATION_FAILED, POLICY_VALIDATION_FAILED, SCOPE_INVALID_CLASS, SCOPE_INVALID_BUDGET, SCOPE_INVALID_RULE, NEGATIVE_CONTROL_MISSING, NEGATIVE_CONTROL_ORACLE_MISMATCH, POLICY_BUILDER_INVALID, AUTHZ_INVALID_WINDOW, AUTHZ_ASSET_UNVERIFIED, PERSONA_UNKNOWN, PERSONA_FORBIDDEN_TOOL, PERSONA_INVALID, ENVELOPE_INVALID, PROMPT_INVALID, PROMPT_PLACEHOLDER_MISSING, AGENT_UNKNOWN_PERSONA, INVALID_SECRET_REF, SBX_IMAGE_MISSING, SBX_INPUT_INTEGRITY_FAILED, SBX_SOURCE_SYMLINK_ESCAPE, SM_RECIPE_INVALID, SM_LOGIN_FAILED, KILL_SCOPE_INVALID, KILL_REF_REQUIRED, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_MISMATCH, GATE2_NO_ONCALL_CONFIGURED, AUDIT_EVENT_INVALID, ASSET_INVALID_IDENTIFIER, ASSET_VERIFICATION_METHOD_NOT_APPLICABLE, CVSS_VECTOR_SCORE_MISMATCH, TRIAGE_REASON_REQUIRED, TRIAGE_EXPIRY_INVALID, TRIAGE_CANONICAL_INVALID, TRIAGE_DUPLICATE_TARGET_INVALID, TRIAGE_RISK_EXPIRY_INVALID, CONNECTOR_UNKNOWN_PROVIDER, CONNECTOR_VALIDATION, MEMORY_EMBED_DIM_MISMATCH, SCHEDULE_NO_ASSETS, SCHEDULE_CRON_INVALID, SCHEDULE_TZ_INVALID, SCHEDULE_TOO_FREQUENT.

## triage

Gate 3 triage (TRIAGE-001, TRIAGE-004): an analyst releases, rejects, marks a duplicate or accepts the risk of a Confirmed finding. Every decision needs a reason, the finding ETag and an Idempotency-Key.

### POST /findings/{id}/release

**releaseFinding**

Moves a Confirmed finding to released. Needs a scored severity and bound evidence, and a reason. Needs finding:triage.

- Operation ID: `releaseFinding`
- Authentication: `bearerAuth` or `sessionCookie`

| Parameter         | In     | Required | Type   | Description                                                                                                                                      |
| ----------------- | ------ | -------- | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `id`              | path   | yes      | string | The `fnd_…` public id of the finding.                                                                                                            |

## oncall

Gate 2 on-call rosters: who is paged for a runtime exception, and in what order.

### GET /oncall/rosters

**List the tenant on-call rosters**

Requires settings:read (Org Admin).

- Operation ID: `listOncallRosters`
- Authentication: `bearerAuth` or `sessionCookie`

#### Response 422

Problem details; code is one of VALIDATION_FAILED, EVIDENCE_INTEGRITY_FAILED, GATE1_PLAN_INVALID, ENVELOPE_VERIFICATION_FAILED, POLICY_VALIDATION_FAILED, SCOPE_INVALID_CLASS, SCOPE_INVALID_BUDGET, SCOPE_INVALID_RULE, NEGATIVE_CONTROL_MISSING, NEGATIVE_CONTROL_ORACLE_MISMATCH, POLICY_BUILDER_INVALID, AUTHZ_INVALID_WINDOW, AUTHZ_ASSET_UNVERIFIED, PERSONA_UNKNOWN, PERSONA_FORBIDDEN_TOOL, PERSONA_INVALID, ENVELOPE_INVALID, PROMPT_INVALID, PROMPT_PLACEHOLDER_MISSING, AGENT_UNKNOWN_PERSONA, INVALID_SECRET_REF, SBX_IMAGE_MISSING, SBX_INPUT_INTEGRITY_FAILED, SBX_SOURCE_SYMLINK_ESCAPE, SM_RECIPE_INVALID, SM_LOGIN_FAILED, KILL_SCOPE_INVALID, KILL_REF_REQUIRED, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_MISMATCH, GATE2_NO_ONCALL_CONFIGURED, AUDIT_EVENT_INVALID, ASSET_INVALID_IDENTIFIER, ASSET_VERIFICATION_METHOD_NOT_APPLICABLE, CVSS_VECTOR_SCORE_MISMATCH, TRIAGE_REASON_REQUIRED, TRIAGE_EXPIRY_INVALID, TRIAGE_CANONICAL_INVALID, TRIAGE_DUPLICATE_TARGET_INVALID, TRIAGE_RISK_EXPIRY_INVALID, CONNECTOR_UNKNOWN_PROVIDER, CONNECTOR_VALIDATION, MEMORY_EMBED_DIM_MISMATCH, SCHEDULE_NO_ASSETS, SCHEDULE_CRON_INVALID, SCHEDULE_TZ_INVALID, SCHEDULE_TOO_FREQUENT.

Content type `application/problem+json`: [Problem](#problem).

### POST /oncall/rosters

**Create an on-call roster**

Requires settings:write (Org Admin). A tenant has at most one active roster. Schedule boundaries without a Z or offset are read in the roster timezone. Audited as oncall.roster.updated.

- Operation ID: `createOncallRoster`
- Authentication: `bearerAuth` or `sessionCookie`

**Request body** (required)

Content type `application/json`: [OncallRosterCreate](#oncallrostercreate).

Example: Primary on a weekly rotation, manager as the last resort.

```json
{
  "name": "Primary rotation",
  "timezone": "Europe/Berlin",
  "members": [
    {
      "userId": "01890a5d-ac96-774b-bcce-b302099a8059",
      "level": 0,
      "orderIndex": 0,
      "channelRefs": ["01890a5d-ac96-774b-bcce-b302099a805b"]
    },
    {
      "userId": "01890a5d-ac96-774b-bcce-b302099a805a",
      "level": 2,
      "orderIndex": 0,
      "channelRefs": ["01890a5d-ac96-774b-bcce-b302099a805b"]
    }
  ],
  "schedules": [
    {
      "userId": "01890a5d-ac96-774b-bcce-b302099a8059",
      "startsAt": "2026-10-19T09:00",
      "endsAt": "2026-10-26T09:00"
    }
  ]
}
```

#### Response 201

The roster, with its ETag and Location.

| Header     | Description                                      |
| ---------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| `ETag`     | Version of the roster, to send back in If-Match. |
| `Location` |                                                  |

Content type `application/json`: [OncallRoster](#oncallroster).

Example: created.

```json
{
  "id": "01890a5d-ac96-774b-bcce-b302099a8057",
```

### GET /oncall/rosters/{id}

**An on-call roster with its members and schedule**

Requires settings:read (Org Admin).

- Operation ID: `getOncallRoster`
- Authentication: `bearerAuth` or `sessionCookie`

| `id`      | path | yes      | string (uuid) |             |

### PATCH /oncall/rosters/{id}

**Change an on-call roster**

Requires settings:write (Org Admin) and the current ETag in If-Match. A members or schedules list replaces the stored list. Audited as oncall.roster.updated.

- Operation ID: `updateOncallRoster`
- Authentication: `bearerAuth` or `sessionCookie`

| Parameter  | In     | Required | Type          | Description |
| ---------- | ------ | -------- | ------------- | ----------- |
| `id`       | path   | yes      | string (uuid) |             |
| `If-Match` | header | yes      | string        |             |

**Request body** (required)

Content type `application/json`: [OncallRosterPatch](#oncallrosterpatch).

Example: rename.

```json
{
  "name": "Night rotation"
}
```

#### Response 200

The updated roster and its new ETag.

| Header | Description                                      |
| ------ | ------------------------------------------------ |
| `ETag` | Version of the roster, to send back in If-Match. |

Content type `application/json`: [OncallRoster](#oncallroster).

Example: updated.

```json
{
  "id": "01890a5d-ac96-774b-bcce-b302099a8057",
  "tenantId": "01890a5d-ac96-774b-bcce-b302099a8058",
  "name": "Primary rotation",
  "timezone": "Europe/Berlin",
  "active": true,
  "stateVersion": 1,
  "members": [
    {
      "id": "01890a5d-ac96-774b-bcce-b302099a8057",
      "userId": "01890a5d-ac96-774b-bcce-b302099a8059",
      "level": 0,
      "orderIndex": 0,
      "channelRefs": ["01890a5d-ac96-774b-bcce-b302099a805b"]
    },
    {
      "id": "01890a5d-ac96-774b-bcce-b302099a8058",
      "userId": "01890a5d-ac96-774b-bcce-b302099a805a",
      "level": 2,
      "orderIndex": 0,
      "channelRefs": ["01890a5d-ac96-774b-bcce-b302099a805b"]
    }
  ],
  "schedules": [
    {
      "id": "01890a5d-ac96-774b-bcce-b302099a8059",
      "userId": "01890a5d-ac96-774b-bcce-b302099a8059",
      "startsAt": "2026-10-19T07:00:00.000Z",
      "endsAt": "2026-10-26T07:00:00.000Z"
    }
  ],
  "createdAt": "2026-10-20T10:00:00.000Z",
  "updatedAt": "2026-10-20T10:00:00.000Z"
}
```

## notifications

Notification channels: email, Slack, Teams, webhook, PagerDuty and Opsgenie destinations. A credential is sent once as `secret`, stored by reference and never returned.

### GET /notification-channels

**List the notification channels**

- Operation ID: `listNotificationChannels`
- Authentication: `bearerAuth` or `sessionCookie`

#### Response 200

The tenant channels, oldest first.

Content type `application/json`: object.

Example: One Slack channel.

```json
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "018f5c2e-7b1a-7d3e-9a4f-2c1d0e9b8a77",

}
```

### POST /notification-channels

**Create a notification channel**

Requires notifications:manage. A secret-bearing kind must send `secret`; it is sealed into the secrets service and only its secret_ref is stored. Email must not send `secret`.

- Operation ID: `createNotificationChannel`
- Authentication: `bearerAuth` or `sessionCookie`

**Request body** (required)

Content type `application/json`: [CreateNotificationChannel](#createnotificationchannel).

Example: Slack webhook.

```json
{
  "kind": "slack",
  "name": "Gate alerts",
  "config": {
    "channel": "appsec-alerts"
  },
  "secret": "https://hooks.slack.com/services/T000/B000/XXXX"
}
```

#### Response 201

The channel as stored, with its secret_ref and no secret material.

Content type `application/json`: [NotificationChannel](#notificationchannel).

Example: A Slack channel.

```json
{
  "id": "018f5c2e-7b1a-7d3e-9a4f-2c1d0e9b8a77",
  "kind": "slack",
  "name": "Gate alerts",
  "status": "active",
  "config": {
    "channel": "appsec-alerts"
  },
  "secretRef": "bw-secret://018f5c2e-0000-7000-8000-000000000001/018f5c2e-7b1a-7d3e-9a4f-2c1d0e9b8a88",
  "createdBy": "018f5c2e-0000-7000-8000-000000000002",
  "createdAt": "2026-10-30T09:00:00.000Z",
  "updatedAt": "2026-10-30T09:00:00.000Z"
}
```

#### Response 400

Problem details; code is one of NOTIFICATION_CHANNEL_INVALID.

Content type `application/problem+json`: [Problem](#problem).

```json
  "type": "https://errors.blackwing.dev/NOTIFICATION_CHANNEL_INVALID",
```

### GET /notification-channels/{id}

**Read a notification channel**

- Operation ID: `getNotificationChannel`
- Authentication: `bearerAuth` or `sessionCookie`

| Parameter | In   | Required | Type          | Description            |
| --------- | ---- | -------- | ------------- | ---------------------- |
| `id`      | path | yes      | string (uuid) | The channel id (UUID). |

#### Response 200

The channel.

Content type `application/json`: [NotificationChannel](#notificationchannel).

Example: A Slack channel.

```json
{
  "id": "018f5c2e-7b1a-7d3e-9a4f-2c1d0e9b8a77",
  "kind": "slack",
  "name": "Gate alerts",
  "status": "active",
  "config": {
    "channel": "appsec-alerts"
  },
  "secretRef": "bw-secret://018f5c2e-0000-7000-8000-000000000001/018f5c2e-7b1a-7d3e-9a4f-2c1d0e9b8a88",
  "createdBy": "018f5c2e-0000-7000-8000-000000000002",
  "createdAt": "2026-10-30T09:00:00.000Z",
  "updatedAt": "2026-10-30T09:00:00.000Z"
}
```

#### Response 409

Problem details; code is one of CONFLICT, ILLEGAL_RUN_TRANSITION, GATE1_NOT_PENDING, GATE1_PLAN_STALE, GATE1_EXPIRED, ENVELOPE_SA_EXPIRED, ENVELOPE_WINDOW_CLOSED, POLICY_ROLLBACK_TARGET_NOT_EARLIER, POLICY_NO_ACTIVE_VERSION, AUTHZ_ILLEGAL_TRANSITION, AUTHZ_NOT_DRAFT, KEK_DISABLED, DB_SERIALIZATION_CONFLICT, KILL_ALREADY_IN_PROGRESS, GATE2_NO_ELIGIBLE_APPROVER, RUN_NOT_ACTIVE, INVALID_TRANSITION, SECRET_NAME_CONFLICT, SECRET_IN_USE, SECRET_DISABLED, ASSET_STALE_WRITE, ASSET_IN_USE, QUOTA_EXCEEDED, ASSET_VERIFICATION_ILLEGAL_TRANSITION, ASSET_CRED_DUPLICATE_ROLE, CHANNEL_NAME_CONFLICT, CHANNEL_SECRET_UNAVAILABLE, CHANNEL_REFERENCED, KEYCLOAK_CONFLICT, FINDING_ILLEGAL_TRANSITION, TRIAGE_PRECONDITION_FAILED, TRIAGE_INVALID_TRANSITION, PLAN_VERSION_IMMUTABLE, GATE2_ILLEGAL_TRANSITION, GATE2_ALREADY_DECIDED.

Content type `application/problem+json`: [Problem](#problem).

#### Response 422

Problem details; code is one of VALIDATION_FAILED, EVIDENCE_INTEGRITY_FAILED, GATE1_PLAN_INVALID, ENVELOPE_VERIFICATION_FAILED, POLICY_VALIDATION_FAILED, SCOPE_INVALID_CLASS, SCOPE_INVALID_BUDGET, SCOPE_INVALID_RULE, NEGATIVE_CONTROL_MISSING, NEGATIVE_CONTROL_ORACLE_MISMATCH, POLICY_BUILDER_INVALID, AUTHZ_INVALID_WINDOW, AUTHZ_ASSET_UNVERIFIED, PERSONA_UNKNOWN, PERSONA_FORBIDDEN_TOOL, PERSONA_INVALID, ENVELOPE_INVALID, PROMPT_INVALID, PROMPT_PLACEHOLDER_MISSING, AGENT_UNKNOWN_PERSONA, INVALID_SECRET_REF, SBX_IMAGE_MISSING, SBX_INPUT_INTEGRITY_FAILED, SBX_SOURCE_SYMLINK_ESCAPE, SM_RECIPE_INVALID, SM_LOGIN_FAILED, KILL_SCOPE_INVALID, KILL_REF_REQUIRED, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_MISMATCH, GATE2_NO_ONCALL_CONFIGURED, AUDIT_EVENT_INVALID, ASSET_INVALID_IDENTIFIER, ASSET_VERIFICATION_METHOD_NOT_APPLICABLE, CVSS_VECTOR_SCORE_MISMATCH, TRIAGE_REASON_REQUIRED, TRIAGE_EXPIRY_INVALID, TRIAGE_CANONICAL_INVALID, TRIAGE_DUPLICATE_TARGET_INVALID, TRIAGE_RISK_EXPIRY_INVALID, CONNECTOR_UNKNOWN_PROVIDER, CONNECTOR_VALIDATION, MEMORY_EMBED_DIM_MISMATCH, SCHEDULE_NO_ASSETS, SCHEDULE_CRON_INVALID, SCHEDULE_TZ_INVALID, SCHEDULE_TOO_FREQUENT.

Content type `application/problem+json`: [Problem](#problem).

### DELETE /notification-channels/{id}

**Disable a notification channel**

Soft-disables the channel; the row and its credential are kept. A channel referenced by active routing rules answers 409 CHANNEL_REFERENCED unless `force=true`.

- Operation ID: `deleteNotificationChannel`
- Authentication: `bearerAuth` or `sessionCookie`

| Parameter | In    | Required | Type                      | Description                                                      |
| --------- | ----- | -------- | ------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`      | path  | yes      | string (uuid)             | The channel id (UUID).                                           |
| `force`   | query | no       | enum: `"true"`, `"false"` | Disable the channel even when active routing rules reference it. |

#### Response 200

The channel, now disabled.

Content type `application/json`: [NotificationChannel](#notificationchannel).

Example: A Slack channel.

```json
{
  "id": "018f5c2e-7b1a-7d3e-9a4f-2c1d0e9b8a77",
  "kind": "slack",
  "name": "Gate alerts",
  "status": "active",
  "config": {
    "channel": "appsec-alerts"
  },
  "secretRef": "bw-secret://018f5c2e-0000-7000-8000-000000000001/018f5c2e-7b1a-7d3e-9a4f-2c1d0e9b8a88",
  "createdBy": "018f5c2e-0000-7000-8000-000000000002",
  "createdAt": "2026-10-30T09:00:00.000Z",
  "updatedAt": "2026-10-30T09:00:00.000Z"
}
```

### PATCH /notification-channels/{id}

**Change a notification channel**

Requires notifications:manage. `config` replaces the settings and is validated for the channel kind. `secret` rotates the credential to a new version. `status` enables or disables delivery. The kind cannot change.

- Operation ID: `updateNotificationChannel`
- Authentication: `bearerAuth` or `sessionCookie`

| Parameter | In   | Required | Type          | Description            |
| --------- | ---- | -------- | ------------- | ---------------------- |
| `id`      | path | yes      | string (uuid) | The channel id (UUID). |

**Request body** (required)

Content type `application/json`: [UpdateNotificationChannel](#updatenotificationchannel).

Example: Disable delivery.

```json
{
  "status": "disabled"
}
```

#### Response 200

The channel after the change. An unchanged body returns it as is.

Content type `application/json`: [NotificationChannel](#notificationchannel).

Example: A Slack channel.

```json
{
  "id": "018f5c2e-7b1a-7d3e-9a4f-2c1d0e9b8a77",
  "kind": "slack",
  "name": "Gate alerts",
  "status": "active",
  "config": {
    "channel": "appsec-alerts"
  },
  "secretRef": "bw-secret://018f5c2e-0000-7000-8000-000000000001/018f5c2e-7b1a-7d3e-9a4f-2c1d0e9b8a88",
  "createdBy": "018f5c2e-0000-7000-8000-000000000002",
  "createdAt": "2026-10-30T09:00:00.000Z",
  "updatedAt": "2026-10-30T09:00:00.000Z"
}
```

Problem details; code is one of NOTIFICATION_CHANNEL_INVALID.

Content type `application/problem+json`: [Problem](#problem).

### GET /notification-routes

**List the notification routing rules**

- Operation ID: `listNotificationRoutes`
- Authentication: `bearerAuth` or `sessionCookie`

#### Response 200

The tenant routing rules, in id order.

Content type `application/json`: object.

Example: One rule.

```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "018f5c2e-7b1a-7d3e-9a4f-2c1d0e9b8a91",
      "event": "kill.fired",
      "assetId": null,
      "severityMin": "critical",
      "channelId": "018f5c2e-7b1a-7d3e-9a4f-2c1d0e9b8a77",
      "recipientSpec": {
        "onCallGroup": "soc-primary"
      },
      "enabled": true,
      "priority": 10,
      "createdBy": "018f5c2e-0000-7000-8000-000000000002",
      "createdAt": "2026-10-30T09:00:00.000Z",
      "updatedAt": "2026-10-30T09:00:00.000Z"
    }
  ]
}
```

Problem details; code is one of VALIDATION_FAILED, EVIDENCE_INTEGRITY_FAILED, GATE1_PLAN_INVALID, ENVELOPE_VERIFICATION_FAILED, POLICY_VALIDATION_FAILED, SCOPE_INVALID_CLASS, SCOPE_INVALID_BUDGET, SCOPE_INVALID_RULE, NEGATIVE_CONTROL_MISSING, NEGATIVE_CONTROL_ORACLE_MISMATCH, POLICY_BUILDER_INVALID, AUTHZ_INVALID_WINDOW, AUTHZ_ASSET_UNVERIFIED, PERSONA_UNKNOWN, PERSONA_FORBIDDEN_TOOL, PERSONA_INVALID, ENVELOPE_INVALID, PROMPT_INVALID, PROMPT_PLACEHOLDER_MISSING, AGENT_UNKNOWN_PERSONA, INVALID_SECRET_REF, SBX_IMAGE_MISSING, SBX_INPUT_INTEGRITY_FAILED, SBX_SOURCE_SYMLINK_ESCAPE, SM_RECIPE_INVALID, SM_LOGIN_FAILED, KILL_SCOPE_INVALID, KILL_REF_REQUIRED, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_MISMATCH, GATE2_NO_ONCALL_CONFIGURED, AUDIT_EVENT_INVALID, ASSET_INVALID_IDENTIFIER, ASSET_VERIFICATION_METHOD_NOT_APPLICABLE, CVSS_VECTOR_SCORE_MISMATCH, TRIAGE_REASON_REQUIRED, TRIAGE_EXPIRY_INVALID, TRIAGE_CANONICAL_INVALID, TRIAGE_DUPLICATE_TARGET_INVALID, TRIAGE_RISK_EXPIRY_INVALID, CONNECTOR_UNKNOWN_PROVIDER, CONNECTOR_VALIDATION, MEMORY_EMBED_DIM_MISMATCH, SCHEDULE_NO_ASSETS, SCHEDULE_CRON_INVALID, SCHEDULE_TZ_INVALID, SCHEDULE_TOO_FREQUENT.

### POST /notification-routes

**Create a notification routing rule**

Requires notifications:manage. The channel must be active in the tenant. `assetId` null (or absent) matches every asset; `event` `*` matches every event.

- Operation ID: `createNotificationRoute`
- Authentication: `bearerAuth` or `sessionCookie`

**Request body** (required)

Content type `application/json`: [CreateNotificationRoute](#createnotificationroute).

Example: SOC on-call for kill events.

```json
{
  "event": "kill.fired",
  "severityMin": "critical",
  "channelId": "018f5c2e-7b1a-7d3e-9a4f-2c1d0e9b8a77",
  "recipientSpec": {
    "onCallGroup": "soc-primary"
  },
  "priority": 10
}
```

#### Response 201

The rule as stored.

Content type `application/json`: [NotificationRoute](#notificationroute).

Example: SOC on-call for kill events.

```json
{
  "id": "018f5c2e-7b1a-7d3e-9a4f-2c1d0e9b8a91",
  "event": "kill.fired",
  "assetId": null,
  "severityMin": "critical",
  "channelId": "018f5c2e-7b1a-7d3e-9a4f-2c1d0e9b8a77",
  "recipientSpec": {
    "onCallGroup": "soc-primary"
  },
  "enabled": true,
  "priority": 10,
  "createdBy": "018f5c2e-0000-7000-8000-000000000002",
  "createdAt": "2026-10-30T09:00:00.000Z",
  "updatedAt": "2026-10-30T09:00:00.000Z"
}
```

### GET /notification-routes/{id}

**Read a notification routing rule**

- Operation ID: `getNotificationRoute`
- Authentication: `bearerAuth` or `sessionCookie`

| Parameter | In   | Required | Type          | Description                 |
| --------- | ---- | -------- | ------------- | --------------------------- |
| `id`      | path | yes      | string (uuid) | The routing rule id (UUID). |

#### Response 200

The rule.

Content type `application/json`: [NotificationRoute](#notificationroute).

Example: SOC on-call for kill events.

```json
{
  "id": "018f5c2e-7b1a-7d3e-9a4f-2c1d0e9b8a91",
  "event": "kill.fired",
  "assetId": null,
  "severityMin": "critical",
  "channelId": "018f5c2e-7b1a-7d3e-9a4f-2c1d0e9b8a77",
  "recipientSpec": {
    "onCallGroup": "soc-primary"
  },
  "enabled": true,
  "priority": 10,
  "createdBy": "018f5c2e-0000-7000-8000-000000000002",
  "createdAt": "2026-10-30T09:00:00.000Z",
  "updatedAt": "2026-10-30T09:00:00.000Z"
}
```

### DELETE /notification-routes/{id}

**Delete a notification routing rule**

Removes the rule and audits the deletion.

- Operation ID: `deleteNotificationRoute`
- Authentication: `bearerAuth` or `sessionCookie`

| Parameter | In   | Required | Type          | Description                 |
| --------- | ---- | -------- | ------------- | --------------------------- |
| `id`      | path | yes      | string (uuid) | The routing rule id (UUID). |

#### Response 200

The rule that was removed.

Content type `application/json`: [NotificationRoute](#notificationroute).

Example: SOC on-call for kill events.

```json
{
  "id": "018f5c2e-7b1a-7d3e-9a4f-2c1d0e9b8a91",
  "event": "kill.fired",
  "assetId": null,
  "severityMin": "critical",
  "channelId": "018f5c2e-7b1a-7d3e-9a4f-2c1d0e9b8a77",
  "recipientSpec": {
    "onCallGroup": "soc-primary"
  },
  "enabled": true,
  "priority": 10,
  "createdBy": "018f5c2e-0000-7000-8000-000000000002",
  "createdAt": "2026-10-30T09:00:00.000Z",
  "updatedAt": "2026-10-30T09:00:00.000Z"
}
```

Problem details; code is one of VALIDATION_FAILED, EVIDENCE_INTEGRITY_FAILED, GATE1_PLAN_INVALID, ENVELOPE_VERIFICATION_FAILED, POLICY_VALIDATION_FAILED, SCOPE_INVALID_CLASS, SCOPE_INVALID_BUDGET, SCOPE_INVALID_RULE, NEGATIVE_CONTROL_MISSING, NEGATIVE_CONTROL_ORACLE_MISMATCH, POLICY_BUILDER_INVALID, AUTHZ_INVALID_WINDOW, AUTHZ_ASSET_UNVERIFIED, PERSONA_UNKNOWN, PERSONA_FORBIDDEN_TOOL, PERSONA_INVALID, ENVELOPE_INVALID, PROMPT_INVALID, PROMPT_PLACEHOLDER_MISSING, AGENT_UNKNOWN_PERSONA, INVALID_SECRET_REF, SBX_IMAGE_MISSING, SBX_INPUT_INTEGRITY_FAILED, SBX_SOURCE_SYMLINK_ESCAPE, SM_RECIPE_INVALID, SM_LOGIN_FAILED, KILL_SCOPE_INVALID, KILL_REF_REQUIRED, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_MISMATCH, GATE2_NO_ONCALL_CONFIGURED, AUDIT_EVENT_INVALID, ASSET_INVALID_IDENTIFIER, ASSET_VERIFICATION_METHOD_NOT_APPLICABLE, CVSS_VECTOR_SCORE_MISMATCH, TRIAGE_REASON_REQUIRED, TRIAGE_EXPIRY_INVALID, TRIAGE_CANONICAL_INVALID, TRIAGE_DUPLICATE_TARGET_INVALID, TRIAGE_RISK_EXPIRY_INVALID, CONNECTOR_UNKNOWN_PROVIDER, CONNECTOR_VALIDATION, MEMORY_EMBED_DIM_MISMATCH, SCHEDULE_NO_ASSETS, SCHEDULE_CRON_INVALID, SCHEDULE_TZ_INVALID, SCHEDULE_TOO_FREQUENT.

### PATCH /notification-routes/{id}

**Change a notification routing rule**

Requires notifications:manage. Only the fields sent change. An empty body is refused. A channel change must name an active channel of the tenant.

- Operation ID: `updateNotificationRoute`
- Authentication: `bearerAuth` or `sessionCookie`

| Parameter | In   | Required | Type          | Description                 |
| --------- | ---- | -------- | ------------- | --------------------------- |
| `id`      | path | yes      | string (uuid) | The routing rule id (UUID). |

**Request body** (required)

Content type `application/json`: [UpdateNotificationRoute](#updatenotificationroute).

Example: Disable the rule.

```json
{
  "enabled": false
}
```

#### Response 200

The rule after the change. An unchanged body returns it as is.

Content type `application/json`: [NotificationRoute](#notificationroute).

Example: SOC on-call for kill events.

```json
{
  "id": "018f5c2e-7b1a-7d3e-9a4f-2c1d0e9b8a91",
  "event": "kill.fired",
  "assetId": null,
  "severityMin": "critical",
  "channelId": "018f5c2e-7b1a-7d3e-9a4f-2c1d0e9b8a77",
  "recipientSpec": {
    "onCallGroup": "soc-primary"
  },
  "enabled": true,
  "priority": 10,
  "createdBy": "018f5c2e-0000-7000-8000-000000000002",
  "createdAt": "2026-10-30T09:00:00.000Z",
  "updatedAt": "2026-10-30T09:00:00.000Z"
```
```json
}
```

## notifications

Notification routing rules: which events go to which channel, optionally per asset, severity and on-call group. A channel named by an enabled rule cannot be disabled without force.

### GET /notification-channels

**List the notification channels**

- Operation ID: `listNotificationChannels`
- Authentication: `bearerAuth` or `sessionCookie`

#### Response 200

The tenant channels, oldest first.

Content type `application/json`: object.

Example: One Slack channel.

```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "018f5c2e-7b1a-7d3e-9a4f-2c1d0e9b8a77",
      "kind": "slack",
      "name": "Gate alerts",
      "status": "active",
      "config": {
        "channel": "appsec-alerts"
      },
      "secretRef": "bw-secret://018f5c2e-0000-7000-8000-000000000001/018f5c2e-7b1a-7d3e-9a4f-2c1d0e9b8a88",
      "createdBy": "018f5c2e-0000-7000-8000-000000000002",
      "createdAt": "2026-10-30T09:00:00.000Z",
      "updatedAt": "2026-10-30T09:00:00.000Z"
    }
  ]
}
```

### POST /notification-channels

**Create a notification channel**

Requires notifications:manage. A secret-bearing kind must send `secret`; it is sealed into the secrets service and only its secret_ref is stored. Email must not send `secret`.

- Operation ID: `createNotificationChannel`
- Authentication: `bearerAuth` or `sessionCookie`

**Request body** (required)

Content type `application/json`: [CreateNotificationChannel](#createnotificationchannel).

Example: Slack webhook.

```json
{
  "kind": "slack",
  "name": "Gate alerts",
  "config": {
    "channel": "appsec-alerts"
  },
  "secret": "https://hooks.slack.com/services/T000/B000/XXXX"
}
```

#### Response 201

The channel as stored, with its secret_ref and no secret material.

Content type `application/json`: [NotificationChannel](#notificationchannel).

Example: A Slack channel.

```json
{
  "id": "018f5c2e-7b1a-7d3e-9a4f-2c1d0e9b8a77",
  "kind": "slack",
  "name": "Gate alerts",
  "status": "active",
  "config": {
    "channel": "appsec-alerts"
  },
  "secretRef": "bw-secret://018f5c2e-0000-7000-8000-000000000001/018f5c2e-7b1a-7d3e-9a4f-2c1d0e9b8a88",
  "createdBy": "018f5c2e-0000-7000-8000-000000000002",
  "createdAt": "2026-10-30T09:00:00.000Z",
  "updatedAt": "2026-10-30T09:00:00.000Z"
}
```

Problem details; code is one of NOTIFICATION_CHANNEL_INVALID.

Content type `application/problem+json`: [Problem](#problem).

### GET /notification-channels/{id}

**Read a notification channel**

- Operation ID: `getNotificationChannel`
- Authentication: `bearerAuth` or `sessionCookie`

| Parameter | In   | Required | Type          | Description            |
| --------- | ---- | -------- | ------------- | ---------------------- |
| `id`      | path | yes      | string (uuid) | The channel id (UUID). |

#### Response 200

The channel.

Content type `application/json`: [NotificationChannel](#notificationchannel).

Example: A Slack channel.

```json
{
  "id": "018f5c2e-7b1a-7d3e-9a4f-2c1d0e9b8a77",
  "kind": "slack",
  "name": "Gate alerts",
  "status": "active",
  "config": {
    "channel": "appsec-alerts"
  },
  "secretRef": "bw-secret://018f5c2e-0000-7000-8000-000000000001/018f5c2e-7b1a-7d3e-9a4f-2c1d0e9b8a88",
  "createdBy": "018f5c2e-0000-7000-8000-000000000002",
  "createdAt": "2026-10-30T09:00:00.000Z",
  "updatedAt": "2026-10-30T09:00:00.000Z"
}
```

Problem details; code is one of VALIDATION_FAILED, EVIDENCE_INTEGRITY_FAILED, GATE1_PLAN_INVALID, ENVELOPE_VERIFICATION_FAILED, POLICY_VALIDATION_FAILED, SCOPE_INVALID_CLASS, SCOPE_INVALID_BUDGET, SCOPE_INVALID_RULE, NEGATIVE_CONTROL_MISSING, NEGATIVE_CONTROL_ORACLE_MISMATCH, POLICY_BUILDER_INVALID, AUTHZ_INVALID_WINDOW, AUTHZ_ASSET_UNVERIFIED, PERSONA_UNKNOWN, PERSONA_FORBIDDEN_TOOL, PERSONA_INVALID, ENVELOPE_INVALID, PROMPT_INVALID, PROMPT_PLACEHOLDER_MISSING, AGENT_UNKNOWN_PERSONA, INVALID_SECRET_REF, SBX_IMAGE_MISSING, SBX_INPUT_INTEGRITY_FAILED, SBX_SOURCE_SYMLINK_ESCAPE, SM_RECIPE_INVALID, SM_LOGIN_FAILED, KILL_SCOPE_INVALID, KILL_REF_REQUIRED, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_MISMATCH, GATE2_NO_ONCALL_CONFIGURED, AUDIT_EVENT_INVALID, ASSET_INVALID_IDENTIFIER, ASSET_VERIFICATION_METHOD_NOT_APPLICABLE, CVSS_VECTOR_SCORE_MISMATCH, TRIAGE_REASON_REQUIRED, TRIAGE_EXPIRY_INVALID, TRIAGE_CANONICAL_INVALID, TRIAGE_DUPLICATE_TARGET_INVALID, TRIAGE_RISK_EXPIRY_INVALID, CONNECTOR_UNKNOWN_PROVIDER, CONNECTOR_VALIDATION, MEMORY_EMBED_DIM_MISMATCH, SCHEDULE_NO_ASSETS, SCHEDULE_CRON_INVALID, SCHEDULE_TZ_INVALID, SCHEDULE_TOO_FREQUENT.

### DELETE /notification-channels/{id}

**Disable a notification channel**

Soft-disables the channel; the row and its credential are kept. A channel referenced by active routing rules answers 409 CHANNEL_REFERENCED unless `force=true`.

- Operation ID: `deleteNotificationChannel`
- Authentication: `bearerAuth` or `sessionCookie`

| Parameter | In    | Required | Type                      | Description                                                      |
| --------- | ----- | -------- | ------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`      | path  | yes      | string (uuid)             | The channel id (UUID).                                           |
| `force`   | query | no       | enum: `"true"`, `"false"` | Disable the channel even when active routing rules reference it. |

#### Response 200

The channel, now disabled.

Content type `application/json`: [NotificationChannel](#notificationchannel).

Example: A Slack channel.

```json
{
  "id": "018f5c2e-7b1a-7d3e-9a4f-2c1d0e9b8a77",
  "kind": "slack",
  "name": "Gate alerts",
  "status": "active",
  "config": {
    "channel": "appsec-alerts"
  },
  "secretRef": "bw-secret://018f5c2e-0000-7000-8000-000000000001/018f5c2e-7b1a-7d3e-9a4f-2c1d0e9b8a88",
  "createdBy": "018f5c2e-0000-7000-8000-000000000002",
  "createdAt": "2026-10-30T09:00:00.000Z",
  "updatedAt": "2026-10-30T09:00:00.000Z"
}
```

### PATCH /notification-channels/{id}

**Change a notification channel**

Requires notifications:manage. `config` replaces the settings and is validated for the channel kind. `secret` rotates the credential to a new version. `status` enables or disables delivery. The kind cannot change.

- Operation ID: `updateNotificationChannel`
- Authentication: `bearerAuth` or `sessionCookie`

| Parameter | In   | Required | Type          | Description            |
| --------- | ---- | -------- | ------------- | ---------------------- |
| `id`      | path | yes      | string (uuid) | The channel id (UUID). |

**Request body** (required)

Content type `application/json`: [UpdateNotificationChannel](#updatenotificationchannel).

Example: Disable delivery.

```json
{
  "status": "disabled"
}
```

#### Response 200

The channel after the change. An unchanged body returns it as is.

Content type `application/json`: [NotificationChannel](#notificationchannel).

Example: A Slack channel.

```json
{
  "id": "018f5c2e-7b1a-7d3e-9a4f-2c1d0e9b8a77",
  "kind": "slack",
  "name": "Gate alerts",
  "status": "active",
  "config": {
    "channel": "appsec-alerts"
  },
  "secretRef": "bw-secret://018f5c2e-0000-7000-8000-000000000001/018f5c2e-7b1a-7d3e-9a4f-2c1d0e9b8a88",
  "createdBy": "018f5c2e-0000-7000-8000-000000000002",
  "createdAt": "2026-10-30T09:00:00.000Z",
  "updatedAt": "2026-10-30T09:00:00.000Z"
}
```

### GET /notification-routes

**List the notification routing rules**

- Operation ID: `listNotificationRoutes`
- Authentication: `bearerAuth` or `sessionCookie`

#### Response 200

The tenant routing rules, in id order.

Content type `application/json`: object.

Example: One rule.

```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "018f5c2e-7b1a-7d3e-9a4f-2c1d0e9b8a91",
      "event": "kill.fired",
      "assetId": null,
      "severityMin": "critical",
      "channelId": "018f5c2e-7b1a-7d3e-9a4f-2c1d0e9b8a77",
      "recipientSpec": {
        "onCallGroup": "soc-primary"
      },
      "enabled": true,
      "priority": 10,
      "createdBy": "018f5c2e-0000-7000-8000-000000000002",
      "createdAt": "2026-10-30T09:00:00.000Z",
      "updatedAt": "2026-10-30T09:00:00.000Z"
    }
  ]
}
```

#### Response 422

Problem details; code is one of VALIDATION_FAILED, EVIDENCE_INTEGRITY_FAILED, GATE1_PLAN_INVALID, ENVELOPE_VERIFICATION_FAILED, POLICY_VALIDATION_FAILED, SCOPE_INVALID_CLASS, SCOPE_INVALID_BUDGET, SCOPE_INVALID_RULE, NEGATIVE_CONTROL_MISSING, NEGATIVE_CONTROL_ORACLE_MISMATCH, POLICY_BUILDER_INVALID, AUTHZ_INVALID_WINDOW, AUTHZ_ASSET_UNVERIFIED, PERSONA_UNKNOWN, PERSONA_FORBIDDEN_TOOL, PERSONA_INVALID, ENVELOPE_INVALID, PROMPT_INVALID, PROMPT_PLACEHOLDER_MISSING, AGENT_UNKNOWN_PERSONA, INVALID_SECRET_REF, SBX_IMAGE_MISSING, SBX_INPUT_INTEGRITY_FAILED, SBX_SOURCE_SYMLINK_ESCAPE, SM_RECIPE_INVALID, SM_LOGIN_FAILED, KILL_SCOPE_INVALID, KILL_REF_REQUIRED, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_MISMATCH, GATE2_NO_ONCALL_CONFIGURED, AUDIT_EVENT_INVALID, ASSET_INVALID_IDENTIFIER, ASSET_VERIFICATION_METHOD_NOT_APPLICABLE, CVSS_VECTOR_SCORE_MISMATCH, TRIAGE_REASON_REQUIRED, TRIAGE_EXPIRY_INVALID, TRIAGE_CANONICAL_INVALID, TRIAGE_DUPLICATE_TARGET_INVALID, TRIAGE_RISK_EXPIRY_INVALID, CONNECTOR_UNKNOWN_PROVIDER, CONNECTOR_VALIDATION, MEMORY_EMBED_DIM_MISMATCH, SCHEDULE_NO_ASSETS, SCHEDULE_CRON_INVALID, SCHEDULE_TZ_INVALID, SCHEDULE_TOO_FREQUENT.

### POST /notification-routes

**Create a notification routing rule**

Requires notifications:manage. The channel must be active in the tenant. `assetId` null (or absent) matches every asset; `event` `*` matches every event.

- Operation ID: `createNotificationRoute`
- Authentication: `bearerAuth` or `sessionCookie`

**Request body** (required)

Content type `application/json`: [CreateNotificationRoute](#createnotificationroute).

Example: SOC on-call for kill events.

```json
{
  "event": "kill.fired",
  "severityMin": "critical",
  "channelId": "018f5c2e-7b1a-7d3e-9a4f-2c1d0e9b8a77",
  "recipientSpec": {
    "onCallGroup": "soc-primary"
  },
  "priority": 10
}
```

#### Response 201

The rule as stored.

Content type `application/json`: [NotificationRoute](#notificationroute).

Example: SOC on-call for kill events.

```json
{
  "id": "018f5c2e-7b1a-7d3e-9a4f-2c1d0e9b8a91",
  "event": "kill.fired",
  "assetId": null,

  "channelId": "018f5c2e-7b1a-7d3e-9a4f-2c1d0e9b8a77",

  "enabled": true,
  "priority": 10,

}
```

### GET /notification-routes/{id}

**Read a notification routing rule**

- Operation ID: `getNotificationRoute`
- Authentication: `bearerAuth` or `sessionCookie`

| Parameter | In   | Required | Type          | Description                 |
| --------- | ---- | -------- | ------------- | --------------------------- |
| `id`      | path | yes      | string (uuid) | The routing rule id (UUID). |

#### Response 200

The rule.

Content type `application/json`: [NotificationRoute](#notificationroute).

Example: SOC on-call for kill events.

```json
{
  "id": "018f5c2e-7b1a-7d3e-9a4f-2c1d0e9b8a91",
  "event": "kill.fired",
  "assetId": null,
  "severityMin": "critical",
  "channelId": "018f5c2e-7b1a-7d3e-9a4f-2c1d0e9b8a77",
  "recipientSpec": {
    "onCallGroup": "soc-primary"
  },
  "enabled": true,
  "priority": 10,
  "createdBy": "018f5c2e-0000-7000-8000-000000000002",
  "createdAt": "2026-10-30T09:00:00.000Z",
  "updatedAt": "2026-10-30T09:00:00.000Z"
}
```

Problem details; code is one of VALIDATION_FAILED, EVIDENCE_INTEGRITY_FAILED, GATE1_PLAN_INVALID, ENVELOPE_VERIFICATION_FAILED, POLICY_VALIDATION_FAILED, SCOPE_INVALID_CLASS, SCOPE_INVALID_BUDGET, SCOPE_INVALID_RULE, NEGATIVE_CONTROL_MISSING, NEGATIVE_CONTROL_ORACLE_MISMATCH, POLICY_BUILDER_INVALID, AUTHZ_INVALID_WINDOW, AUTHZ_ASSET_UNVERIFIED, PERSONA_UNKNOWN, PERSONA_FORBIDDEN_TOOL, PERSONA_INVALID, ENVELOPE_INVALID, PROMPT_INVALID, PROMPT_PLACEHOLDER_MISSING, AGENT_UNKNOWN_PERSONA, INVALID_SECRET_REF, SBX_IMAGE_MISSING, SBX_INPUT_INTEGRITY_FAILED, SBX_SOURCE_SYMLINK_ESCAPE, SM_RECIPE_INVALID, SM_LOGIN_FAILED, KILL_SCOPE_INVALID, KILL_REF_REQUIRED, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_MISMATCH, GATE2_NO_ONCALL_CONFIGURED, AUDIT_EVENT_INVALID, ASSET_INVALID_IDENTIFIER, ASSET_VERIFICATION_METHOD_NOT_APPLICABLE, CVSS_VECTOR_SCORE_MISMATCH, TRIAGE_REASON_REQUIRED, TRIAGE_EXPIRY_INVALID, TRIAGE_CANONICAL_INVALID, TRIAGE_DUPLICATE_TARGET_INVALID, TRIAGE_RISK_EXPIRY_INVALID, CONNECTOR_UNKNOWN_PROVIDER, CONNECTOR_VALIDATION, MEMORY_EMBED_DIM_MISMATCH, SCHEDULE_NO_ASSETS, SCHEDULE_CRON_INVALID, SCHEDULE_TZ_INVALID, SCHEDULE_TOO_FREQUENT.

### DELETE /notification-routes/{id}

**Delete a notification routing rule**

Removes the rule and audits the deletion.

- Operation ID: `deleteNotificationRoute`
- Authentication: `bearerAuth` or `sessionCookie`

| Parameter | In   | Required | Type          | Description                 |
| --------- | ---- | -------- | ------------- | --------------------------- |
| `id`      | path | yes      | string (uuid) | The routing rule id (UUID). |

#### Response 200

The rule that was removed.

Content type `application/json`: [NotificationRoute](#notificationroute).

Example: SOC on-call for kill events.

```json
{
  "id": "018f5c2e-7b1a-7d3e-9a4f-2c1d0e9b8a91",
  "event": "kill.fired",
  "assetId": null,
  "severityMin": "critical",
  "channelId": "018f5c2e-7b1a-7d3e-9a4f-2c1d0e9b8a77",
  "recipientSpec": {
    "onCallGroup": "soc-primary"
  },
  "enabled": true,
  "priority": 10,
  "createdBy": "018f5c2e-0000-7000-8000-000000000002",
  "createdAt": "2026-10-30T09:00:00.000Z",
  "updatedAt": "2026-10-30T09:00:00.000Z"
}
```

### PATCH /notification-routes/{id}

**Change a notification routing rule**

Requires notifications:manage. Only the fields sent change. An empty body is refused. A channel change must name an active channel of the tenant.

- Operation ID: `updateNotificationRoute`
- Authentication: `bearerAuth` or `sessionCookie`

| Parameter | In   | Required | Type          | Description                 |
| --------- | ---- | -------- | ------------- | --------------------------- |
| `id`      | path | yes      | string (uuid) | The routing rule id (UUID). |

**Request body** (required)

Content type `application/json`: [UpdateNotificationRoute](#updatenotificationroute).

Example: Disable the rule.

```json
{
  "enabled": false
}
```

#### Response 200

The rule after the change. An unchanged body returns it as is.

Content type `application/json`: [NotificationRoute](#notificationroute).

Example: SOC on-call for kill events.

```json
{
  "id": "018f5c2e-7b1a-7d3e-9a4f-2c1d0e9b8a91",
  "event": "kill.fired",
  "assetId": null,
  "severityMin": "critical",
  "channelId": "018f5c2e-7b1a-7d3e-9a4f-2c1d0e9b8a77",
  "recipientSpec": {
    "onCallGroup": "soc-primary"
  },
  "enabled": true,
  "priority": 10,
  "createdBy": "018f5c2e-0000-7000-8000-000000000002",
  "createdAt": "2026-10-30T09:00:00.000Z",
  "updatedAt": "2026-10-30T09:00:00.000Z"
}
```

#### Response 400

Problem details; code is one of NOTIFICATION_ROUTE_INVALID.

## rbac

Service accounts: non-human tenant principals that own API and CI tokens. Approval and administrative roles are refused.

### GET /service-accounts

**List the service accounts of the tenant**

- Operation ID: `listServiceAccounts`
- Authentication: `bearerAuth` or `sessionCookie`

| Parameter | In    | Required | Type    | Description                                        |
| --------- | ----- | -------- | ------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `cursor`  | query | no       | string  | Opaque cursor from the previous page `nextCursor`. |
| `limit`   | query | no       | integer | Page size, 1 to 200 (default 50).                  |

#### Response 200

One page of service accounts.

Content type `application/json`: object.

Example: One active CI service account, no further pages.

```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "0198f0a0-0000-7000-8000-0000000000a1",
      "name": "ci-scanner",
      "description": "Runs the nightly regression scan.",
      "roles": ["ci_pipeline"],
      "ownerUserId": "0198f0a0-0000-7000-8000-0000000000b1",
      "status": "active",
      "stateVersion": 0,
      "createdAt": "2026-10-30T10:00:00.000Z",
      "updatedAt": "2026-10-30T10:00:00.000Z"
    }
  ],
  "nextCursor": null
}
```

Problem details; code is one of INVALID_CURSOR.

Content type `application/problem+json`: [Problem](#problem).

### POST /service-accounts

**Create a service account**

The name is unique per tenant (409 when taken). The owner must be a member of the tenant (422 otherwise). Approval and administrative roles are refused (422).

- Operation ID: `createServiceAccount`
- Authentication: `bearerAuth` or `sessionCookie`

**Request body** (required)

Content type `application/json`: [ServiceAccountCreate](#serviceaccountcreate).

Example: A least-privilege CI account.

```json
{
  "name": "ci-scanner",
  "roles": ["ci_pipeline"],
  "ownerUserId": "0198f0a0-0000-7000-8000-0000000000b1"
}
```

#### Response 201

The created service account at stateVersion 0.

| Header | Description                                                                             |
| ------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `ETag` | Strong validator of this service account state. Send it in If-Match on PATCH or DELETE. |

Content type `application/json`: [ServiceAccount](#serviceaccount).

Example: An active CI service account.

```json
{
  "id": "0198f0a0-0000-7000-8000-0000000000a1",
  "name": "ci-scanner",
  "description": "Runs the nightly regression scan.",
  "roles": ["ci_pipeline"],
  "ownerUserId": "0198f0a0-0000-7000-8000-0000000000b1",
  "status": "active",
  "stateVersion": 0,
  "createdAt": "2026-10-30T10:00:00.000Z",
  "updatedAt": "2026-10-30T10:00:00.000Z"
}
```

### GET /service-accounts/{id}

**Read a service account**

- Operation ID: `getServiceAccount`
- Authentication: `bearerAuth` or `sessionCookie`

| Parameter | In   | Required | Type          | Description                             |
| --------- | ---- | -------- | ------------- | --------------------------------------- |
| `id`      | path | yes      | string (uuid) | The id of the service account (a UUID). |

#### Response 200

The service account and its ETag.

| Header | Description                                                                             |
| ------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `ETag` | Strong validator of this service account state. Send it in If-Match on PATCH or DELETE. |

Content type `application/json`: [ServiceAccount](#serviceaccount).

Example: An active CI service account.

```json
{
  "id": "0198f0a0-0000-7000-8000-0000000000a1",
  "name": "ci-scanner",
  "description": "Runs the nightly regression scan.",
  "roles": ["ci_pipeline"],
  "ownerUserId": "0198f0a0-0000-7000-8000-0000000000b1",
  "status": "active",
  "stateVersion": 0,
  "createdAt": "2026-10-30T10:00:00.000Z",
  "updatedAt": "2026-10-30T10:00:00.000Z"
}
```

### DELETE /service-accounts/{id}

**Disable a service account (soft delete)**

Sets status to disabled. Nothing is removed. A disabled account authenticates nothing. Requires If-Match.

- Operation ID: `disableServiceAccount`
- Authentication: `bearerAuth` or `sessionCookie`

| Parameter  | In     | Required | Type          | Description                                                                                             |
| ---------- | ------ | -------- | ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`       | path   | yes      | string (uuid) | The id of the service account (a UUID).                                                                 |
| `If-Match` | header | yes      | string        | The ETag of the service account being changed (from GET). A stale value answers 412, a missing one 428. |

#### Response 200

The disabled service account and its new ETag.

| Header | Description                                                                             |
| ------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `ETag` | Strong validator of this service account state. Send it in If-Match on PATCH or DELETE. |

Content type `application/json`: [ServiceAccount](#serviceaccount).

Example: An active CI service account.

```json
{
  "id": "0198f0a0-0000-7000-8000-0000000000a1",
  "name": "ci-scanner",
  "description": "Runs the nightly regression scan.",
  "roles": ["ci_pipeline"],
  "ownerUserId": "0198f0a0-0000-7000-8000-0000000000b1",
  "status": "active",
  "stateVersion": 0,
  "createdAt": "2026-10-30T10:00:00.000Z",
  "updatedAt": "2026-10-30T10:00:00.000Z"
}
```

### PATCH /service-accounts/{id}

**Change a service account**

Requires If-Match. Changes the name, description, roles or status (set `disabled` to disable). The owner is not writable.

- Operation ID: `updateServiceAccount`
- Authentication: `bearerAuth` or `sessionCookie`

| Parameter  | In     | Required | Type          | Description                                                                                             |
| ---------- | ------ | -------- | ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`       | path   | yes      | string (uuid) | The id of the service account (a UUID).                                                                 |
| `If-Match` | header | yes      | string        | The ETag of the service account being changed (from GET). A stale value answers 412, a missing one 428. |

**Request body** (required)

Content type `application/json`: [ServiceAccountUpdate](#serviceaccountupdate).

#### Response 200

The service account after the change and its new ETag.

| Header | Description                                                                             |
| ------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `ETag` | Strong validator of this service account state. Send it in If-Match on PATCH or DELETE. |

Content type `application/json`: [ServiceAccount](#serviceaccount).

Example: An active CI service account.

```json
{
  "id": "0198f0a0-0000-7000-8000-0000000000a1",
  "name": "ci-scanner",
  "description": "Runs the nightly regression scan.",
  "roles": ["ci_pipeline"],
  "ownerUserId": "0198f0a0-0000-7000-8000-0000000000b1",
  "status": "active",
  "stateVersion": 0,
  "createdAt": "2026-10-30T10:00:00.000Z",
  "updatedAt": "2026-10-30T10:00:00.000Z"
}
```

## secrets

Write-only secrets: create, replace and disable; metadata is readable, a value never is.

### GET /secrets

**List secret metadata**

Metadata only: never a value or an envelope. Cursor-paginated by creation order.

- Operation ID: `listSecrets`
- Authentication: `bearerAuth` or `sessionCookie`

| Parameter | In    | Required | Type    | Description                                        |
| --------- | ----- | -------- | ------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `cursor`  | query | no       | string  | Opaque cursor from the previous page `nextCursor`. |
| `limit`   | query | no       | integer | Page size, 1 to 200 (default 50).                  |

#### Response 200

A page of secret metadata.

Content type `application/json`: [SecretMetadataPage](#secretmetadatapage).

Example: page.

```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "secretId": "01890a5d-ac96-774b-bcce-b302099a8057",
      "secretRef": "bw-secret://01890a5d-ac96-774b-bcce-b302099a8058/01890a5d-ac96-774b-bcce-b302099a8057",
      "name": "staging-api-key",
      "type": "api_key",
      "purpose": "Authenticated scans of staging",
      "backend": "openbao",
      "status": "active",
      "currentVersion": 1,
      "createdAt": "2026-10-22T10:00:00.000Z",
      "updatedAt": "2026-10-22T10:00:00.000Z"
    }
  ],
  "nextCursor": null,
  "hasMore": false
}
```

### POST /secrets

**Create a secret**

Encrypts the value into the tenant envelope and answers with the secret_ref. The value is never returned and never logged. Idempotency-Key is required: a retry with the same key and body returns the first result.

- Operation ID: `createSecret`
- Authentication: `bearerAuth` or `sessionCookie`

| Parameter         | In     | Required | Type   | Description |
| ----------------- | ------ | -------- | ------ | ----------- |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | yes      | string |             |

**Request body** (required)

Content type `application/json`: [CreateSecretRequest](#createsecretrequest).

Example: An API key.

```json
{
  "name": "staging-api-key",
  "type": "api_key",
  "purpose": "Authenticated scans of staging",
  "value": "example-value-not-a-real-key"
}
```

#### Response 201

Created. The Location is the secret; no value is returned.

| Header     | Description                                        |
| ---------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `Location` | URL of the secret.                                 |
| `ETag`     | Version of the resource, to send back in If-Match. |

Content type `application/json`: [SecretWriteResponse](#secretwriteresponse).

Example: created.

```json
{
  "secretId": "01890a5d-ac96-774b-bcce-b302099a8057",
  "secretRef": "bw-secret://01890a5d-ac96-774b-bcce-b302099a8058/01890a5d-ac96-774b-bcce-b302099a8057",
  "version": 1
}
```

### GET /secrets/{id}

**Read secret metadata**

Metadata only: there is no way to read a value back.

- Operation ID: `getSecret`
- Authentication: `bearerAuth` or `sessionCookie`

| Parameter | In   | Required | Type          | Description |
| --------- | ---- | -------- | ------------- | ----------- |
| `id`      | path | yes      | string (uuid) |             |

#### Response 200

The secret metadata.

| Header | Description                                        |
| ------ | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `ETag` | Version of the resource, to send back in If-Match. |

Content type `application/json`: [SecretMetadata](#secretmetadata).

Example: metadata.

```json
{
  "secretId": "01890a5d-ac96-774b-bcce-b302099a8057",

}
```

### PUT /secrets/{id}

**Replace a secret value**

Stores the value as a new version and increments currentVersion. If-Match is optional: send the ETag of the version you read to fail with 412 when someone else updated first.

- Operation ID: `updateSecret`
- Authentication: `bearerAuth` or `sessionCookie`

| Parameter  | In     | Required | Type          | Description                                                    |
| ---------- | ------ | -------- | ------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`       | path   | yes      | string (uuid) |                                                                |
| `If-Match` | header | no       | string        | ETag of the version being replaced; a stale value answers 412. |

**Request body** (required)

Content type `application/json`: [UpdateSecretRequest](#updatesecretrequest).

Example: replace.

```json
{
  "value": "another-example-value"
}
```

#### Response 200

The new version; no value is returned.

| Header | Description                                        |
| ------ | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `ETag` | Version of the resource, to send back in If-Match. |

Content type `application/json`: [SecretWriteResponse](#secretwriteresponse).

Example: updated.

```json
{
  "secretId": "01890a5d-ac96-774b-bcce-b302099a8057",
  "secretRef": "bw-secret://01890a5d-ac96-774b-bcce-b302099a8058/01890a5d-ac96-774b-bcce-b302099a8057",
  "version": 2
}
```

### DELETE /secrets/{id}

**Disable a secret**

Soft delete: sets status to disabled. A secret that other resources still reference answers 409 SECRET_IN_USE, naming the resource types; repeat with force=true to disable it anyway. Hard delete only happens through the shred flow.

- Operation ID: `deleteSecret`
- Authentication: `bearerAuth` or `sessionCookie`

| Parameter | In    | Required | Type          | Description                                         |
| --------- | ----- | -------- | ------------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`      | path  | yes      | string (uuid) |                                                     |
| `force`   | query | no       | boolean       | Disable even though the secret is still referenced. |

#### Response 200

The secret, now disabled (also when it already was).

| Header | Description                                        |
| ------ | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `ETag` | Version of the resource, to send back in If-Match. |

Content type `application/json`: [SecretMetadata](#secretmetadata).

Example: disabled.

```json
{
  "secretId": "01890a5d-ac96-774b-bcce-b302099a8057",
  "secretRef": "bw-secret://01890a5d-ac96-774b-bcce-b302099a8058/01890a5d-ac96-774b-bcce-b302099a8057",
  "name": "staging-api-key",
  "type": "api_key",
  "purpose": "Authenticated scans of staging",
  "backend": "openbao",
  "status": "disabled",
  "currentVersion": 1,
  "createdAt": "2026-10-22T10:00:00.000Z",
  "updatedAt": "2026-10-22T10:00:00.000Z"
}
```

```json
  "title": "Secret is still referenced",
  "status": 409,
  "code": "SECRET_IN_USE",
  "traceId": "4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736"
}
```

#### Response 422

Problem details; code is one of VALIDATION_FAILED.

Content type `application/problem+json`: [Problem](#problem).

Example: Validation failed.

```json
{
  "type": "https://errors.blackwing.dev/VALIDATION_FAILED",
  "title": "Validation failed",
  "status": 422,
  "code": "VALIDATION_FAILED",
  "traceId": "4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736"
}
```

#### Response 429

Problem details; code is one of RATE_LIMITED, CONNECTOR_RATE_LIMITED.

Content type `application/problem+json`: [Problem](#problem).

Example: Too many requests.

```json
{
  "type": "https://errors.blackwing.dev/RATE_LIMITED",
  "title": "Too many requests",
  "status": 429,
  "code": "RATE_LIMITED",
  "traceId": "4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736"
}
```

Example: Ticket connector rate limited.

```json
{
  "type": "https://errors.blackwing.dev/CONNECTOR_RATE_LIMITED",
  "title": "Ticket connector rate limited",
  "status": 429,
  "code": "CONNECTOR_RATE_LIMITED",
  "traceId": "4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736"
}
```

#### Response 500

Problem details; code is one of INTERNAL.

Content type `application/problem+json`: [Problem](#problem).

Example: Internal server error.

```json
{
  "type": "https://errors.blackwing.dev/INTERNAL",
  "title": "Internal server error",
  "status": 500,
  "code": "INTERNAL",
  "traceId": "4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736"
}
```

| `assetId`       | string or null                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | no       |             |
| `severityMin`   | enum: `"info"`, `"low"`, `"medium"`, `"high"`, `"critical"`                                                                                                                                                                                  | yes      |             |
| `channelId`     | string                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | yes      |             |
| `recipientSpec` | object                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | yes      |             |

| `priority`      | integer                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | yes      |             |

Full schema:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "event": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string",
          "const": "*"
        },
        {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "gate1.requested",
            "gate2.exception",
            "gate3.release_requested",
            "run.completed",
            "run.failed",
            "kill.fired",
            "soc.test_window",
            "soc.window_opened",
            "budget.cap",
            "finding.released",
            "system.alert"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    "assetId": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "severityMin": {
      "default": "info",
      "type": "string",
      "enum": ["info", "low", "medium", "high", "critical"]
    },
    "channelId": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$"
    },
    "recipientSpec": {
      "default": {},
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "emails": {
          "minItems": 1,
          "maxItems": 20,
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string",
            "maxLength": 254,
            "format": "email",
            "pattern": "^(?:[A-Za-z0-9_'+\\-]+\\.)*[A-Za-z0-9_'+\\-]*[A-Za-z0-9_+-]@(?:[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9\\-]*\\.)+[A-Za-z]{2,}$"
          }
        },
        "onCallGroup": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "maxLength": 120,
          "pattern": "^[^\\p{Cc}\\p{Zl}\\p{Zp}]+$"
        }
      },
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "enabled": {
      "default": true,
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "priority": {
      "default": 0,
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": -1000,
      "maximum": 1000
    }
  },
  "required": ["event", "severityMin", "channelId", "recipientSpec", "enabled", "priority"],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

```json
        "type": "string",

      }
    },
```

```json
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "rules": {
          "maxItems": 1000,
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "effect": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": ["include", "exclude"]
              },
              "host": {},
              "cidr": {},
              "ports": {
                "minItems": 1,
                "maxItems": 100,
                "type": "array",
                "items": {}
              },

                "minItems": 1,
                "maxItems": 100,
                "type": "array",
                "items": {}
              },
              "methods": {
                "minItems": 1,
                "maxItems": 100,
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "enum": ["GET", "HEAD", "OPTIONS", "POST", "PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE", "CONNECT"]
                }
              }
            },
            "required": ["effect"],
            "additionalProperties": false
          }
        }
      },
      "required": ["rules"],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },

        "maxLength": 120
      }

          "maximum": 10000000

        }
      },

    },

        "type": "object",

            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1,
            "maxLength": 120
          },

            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1,
            "maxLength": 64
          },

          }

      }
    },
```
