### PersonaRegistryView

| Property               | Type                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | Required | Description |
| ---------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `name`                 | enum: `"orchestrator"`, `"planner"`, `"sub-planner"`, `"passive-recon"`, `"osint"`, `"active-recon"`, `"threat-intel"`, `"source-spec-ingestion"`, `"session-setup"`, `"web-api-specialist"`, `"auth-logic-specialist"`, `"infrastructure-specialist"`, `"code-specialist"`, `"exploit-developer"`, `"mentor"`, `"reflector"`, `"validator-assistant"`, `"reporter"`, `"remediation"` | yes      |             |
| `mandate`              | string                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | yes      |             |
| `promptVersion`        | string                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | yes      |             |
| `tierAlias`            | enum: `"deep"`, `"standard"`, `"fast"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | yes      |             |
| `effective`            | object                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | yes      |             |
| `overridden`           | array of enum: `"effort"`, `"maxTurns"`, `"maxBudgetUsd"`, `"lowerStandardTier"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | yes      |             |
| `allowedTools`         | array of string                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | yes      |             |

| `declaredOracleTypes`  | array of enum: `"reflected_marker"`, `"status_diff"`, `"timing_with_baseline"`, `"out_of_band"`, `"access_matrix"`, `"error_signature"`, `"file_read"`, `"header_flag"`                                                                                                                                                                                                               | yes      |             |

| `helpers`              | array of object                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | yes      |             |

Full schema:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "orchestrator",
        "planner",
        "sub-planner",
        "passive-recon",
        "osint",
        "active-recon",
        "threat-intel",
        "source-spec-ingestion",
        "session-setup",
        "web-api-specialist",
        "auth-logic-specialist",
        "infrastructure-specialist",
        "code-specialist",
        "exploit-developer",
        "mentor",
        "reflector",
        "validator-assistant",
        "reporter",
        "remediation"
      ]
    },
    "mandate": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1
    },
    "promptVersion": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^\\d+\\.\\d+\\.\\d+$"
    },
    "tierAlias": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": ["deep", "standard", "fast"]
    },
    "effective": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "model": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1
        },
        "effort": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": ["low", "medium", "high", "xhigh", "max"]
        },
        "maxTurns": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 1,
          "maximum": 9007199254740991
        },
        "maxBudgetUsd": {
          "type": "number",
          "exclusiveMinimum": 0
        }
      },
      "required": ["model", "effort", "maxTurns", "maxBudgetUsd"],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "overridden": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "enum": ["effort", "maxTurns", "maxBudgetUsd", "lowerStandardTier"]
      }
    },
    "allowedTools": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "minLength": 1
      }
    },
    "disallowedTools": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "minLength": 1
      }
    },
    "declaredOracleTypes": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "enum": [
          "reflected_marker",
          "status_diff",
          "timing_with_baseline",
          "out_of_band",
          "access_matrix",
          "error_signature",
          "file_read",
          "header_flag"
        ]
      }
    },
    "inputs": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "minLength": 1
      }
    },
    "intrusivenessCeiling": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": ["passive", "active_safe", "state_changing"]
    },
    "requiresSubmission": {
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "helpers": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "name": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1
          },
          "description": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1
          },
          "tierAlias": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": ["deep", "standard", "fast"]
          },
          "allowedTools": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "string",
              "minLength": 1
            }
          }
        },
        "required": ["name", "description", "tierAlias", "allowedTools"],
        "additionalProperties": false
      }
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "name",
    "mandate",
    "promptVersion",
    "tierAlias",
    "effective",
    "overridden",
    "allowedTools",
    "disallowedTools",
    "declaredOracleTypes",
    "inputs",
    "intrusivenessCeiling",
    "requiresSubmission",
    "helpers"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

### PlanDiff

| Property      | Type            | Required | Description |
| ------------- | --------------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `fromVersion` | integer         | yes      |             |
| `toVersion`   | integer         | yes      |             |
| `added`       | array of object | yes      |             |
| `removed`     | array of object | yes      |             |
| `modified`    | array of object | yes      |             |

Full schema:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "fromVersion": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 9007199254740991
    },
    "toVersion": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 9007199254740991
    },
    "added": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "caseId": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$"
          },
          "title": {
            "type": "string"
          }
        },
        "required": ["caseId", "title"],
        "additionalProperties": false
      }
    },
    "removed": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "caseId": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$"
          },
          "title": {
            "type": "string"
          }
        },
        "required": ["caseId", "title"],
        "additionalProperties": false
      }
    },
    "modified": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "caseId": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$"
          },
          "title": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "changes": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "object",
              "properties": {
                "field": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "enum": [
                    "class",
                    "title",
                    "status",
                    "budget",
                    "oracle",
                    "negative_control",
                    "targets",
                    "roles",
                    "owasp_refs",
                    "wstg_refs",
                    "asvs_refs",
                    "cwe_candidates"
                  ]
                },
                "before": {},
                "after": {}
              },
              "required": ["field", "before", "after"],
              "additionalProperties": false
            }
          }
        },
        "required": ["caseId", "title", "changes"],
        "additionalProperties": false
      }
    }
  },
  "required": ["fromVersion", "toVersion", "added", "removed", "modified"],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

### PlanValidationResult

| Property        | Type               | Required | Description |
| --------------- | ------------------ | -------- | ----------- |
| `planId`        | string             | yes      |             |
| `runId`         | string             | yes      |             |
| `version`       | integer            | yes      |             |
| `saId`          | string or null     | yes      |             |
| `ok`            | boolean            | yes      |             |
| `gate1Required` | boolean            | yes      |             |
| `violations`    | array of object    | yes      |             |
| `budgetTotals`  | object             | yes      |             |
| `validatedAt`   | string (date-time) | yes      |             |

Full schema:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "planId": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$"
    },
    "runId": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$"
    },
    "version": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 9007199254740991
    },
    "saId": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "ok": {
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "gate1Required": {
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "violations": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "code": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
              "PLAN_SA_MISSING",
              "PLAN_SA_NOT_ACTIVE",
              "PLAN_CLASS_DESTRUCTIVE_BLOCKED",
              "PLAN_CLASS_EXCEEDS_SA",
              "PLAN_STATE_CHANGING_NOT_AUTHORISED",
              "PLAN_TARGET_OUT_OF_SCOPE",
              "PLAN_ROLE_UNKNOWN",
              "PLAN_ORACLE_MISSING",
              "PLAN_NEGATIVE_CONTROL_MISSING",
              "PLAN_BUDGET_EXCEEDED",
              "PLAN_POLICY_DENIED",
              "PLAN_POLICY_EVAL_FAILED"
            ]
          },
          "caseId": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "type": "string",
                "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$"
              },
              {
                "type": "null"
              }
            ]
          },
          "policyId": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "type": "string",
                "minLength": 1,
                "maxLength": 128
              },
              {
                "type": "null"
              }
            ]
          },
          "message": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1,
            "maxLength": 256
          }
        },
        "required": ["code", "caseId", "policyId", "message"],
        "additionalProperties": false
      }
    },
    "budgetTotals": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "totalRequests": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0,
          "maximum": 9007199254740991
        },
        "totalBytes": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0,
          "maximum": 9007199254740991
        },
        "perClassCounts": {
          "type": "object",
          "properties": {
            "passive": {
              "type": "integer",
              "minimum": 0,
              "maximum": 9007199254740991
            },
            "active_safe": {
              "type": "integer",
              "minimum": 0,
              "maximum": 9007199254740991
            },
            "state_changing": {
              "type": "integer",
              "minimum": 0,
              "maximum": 9007199254740991
            },
            "destructive": {
              "type": "integer",
              "minimum": 0,
              "maximum": 9007199254740991
            }
          },
          "required": ["passive", "active_safe", "state_changing", "destructive"],
          "additionalProperties": false
        }
      },
      "required": ["totalRequests", "totalBytes", "perClassCounts"],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "validatedAt": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "date-time",
      "pattern": "^(?:(?:\\d\\d[2468][048]|\\d\\d[13579][26]|\\d\\d0[48]|[02468][048]00|[13579][26]00)-02-29|\\d{4}-(?:(?:0[13578]|1[02])-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|3[01])|(?:0[469]|11)-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|30)|(?:02)-(?:0[1-9]|1\\d|2[0-8])))T(?:(?:[01]\\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\\d:[0-5]\\d(?:\\.\\d+)?(?:Z))$"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "planId",
    "runId",
    "version",
    "saId",
    "ok",
    "gate1Required",
    "violations",
    "budgetTotals",
    "validatedAt"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

### PreflightDryRun

| Property           | Type            | Required | Description |
| ------------------ | --------------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `requestId`        | string          | yes      |             |
| `dryRun`           | boolean         | yes      |             |
| `ok`               | boolean         | yes      |             |
| `results`          | array of object | yes      |             |
| `blockingFailures` | array of string | yes      |             |

Full schema:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "requestId": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^areq_[A-Za-z0-9]+$"
    },
    "dryRun": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "const": true
    },
    "ok": {
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "results": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1
          },
          "title": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1
          },
          "severity": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": ["blocking", "warning"]
          },
          "status": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": ["pass", "fail", "skip"]
          },
          "detail": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "code": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1
          },
          "remediation": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1
          },
          "evidence": {
            "type": "object",
            "propertyNames": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "additionalProperties": {
              "type": ["string", "number", "boolean", "null"]
            }
          }
        },
        "required": ["id", "title", "severity", "status", "detail"],
        "additionalProperties": false
      }
    },
    "blockingFailures": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "minLength": 1
      }
    }
  },
  "required": ["requestId", "dryRun", "ok", "results", "blockingFailures"],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
```
```json
    "secretId": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$"

    "secretRef": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "name": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "type": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "password",
            "api_key",
            "token",
            "certificate",
            "ssh_key",
            "webhook_secret",
            "kms_ref",
            "generic"
          ]
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
```

| Property      | Type                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | Required | Description |

Full schema:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "nodes": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1,
            "maxLength": 4096
          },
          "kind": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
              "asset",
              "host",
              "service",
              "technology",
              "endpoint",
              "parameter",
              "role",
              "spec_document",
              "schema_object",
              "auth_scheme",
              "source_route",
              "config_item"
            ]
          },
          "label": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1,
            "maxLength": 256
          },
          "inScope": {
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "confidence": {
            "type": "number",
            "minimum": 0,
            "maximum": 1
          },
          "degree": {
            "type": "integer",
            "minimum": 0,
            "maximum": 9007199254740991
          },
          "provenance": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "runId": {
                "type": "string",
                "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$"
              },
              "tool": {
                "type": "string",
                "minLength": 1,
                "maxLength": 256
              },
              "firstSeenAt": {
                "type": "string",
                "format": "date-time",
                "pattern": "^(?:(?:\\d\\d[2468][048]|\\d\\d[13579][26]|\\d\\d0[48]|[02468][048]00|[13579][26]00)-02-29|\\d{4}-(?:(?:0[13578]|1[02])-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|3[01])|(?:0[469]|11)-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|30)|(?:02)-(?:0[1-9]|1\\d|2[0-8])))T(?:(?:[01]\\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\\d:[0-5]\\d\\.\\d{3}(?:Z))$"
              },
              "lastSeenAt": {
                "type": "string",
                "format": "date-time",
                "pattern": "^(?:(?:\\d\\d[2468][048]|\\d\\d[13579][26]|\\d\\d0[48]|[02468][048]00|[13579][26]00)-02-29|\\d{4}-(?:(?:0[13578]|1[02])-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|3[01])|(?:0[469]|11)-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|30)|(?:02)-(?:0[1-9]|1\\d|2[0-8])))T(?:(?:[01]\\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\\d:[0-5]\\d\\.\\d{3}(?:Z))$"
              }
            },
            "required": ["runId", "firstSeenAt", "lastSeenAt"],
            "additionalProperties": false
          }
        },
        "required": ["id", "kind", "label", "confidence", "degree", "provenance"],
        "additionalProperties": false
      }
    },
    "edges": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "kind": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
              "RESOLVES_TO",
              "EXPOSES",
              "RUNS",
              "SERVES",
              "HAS_PARAM",
              "CAN_ACCESS",
              "DEFINED_IN",
              "SECURED_BY",
              "MAPS_TO"
            ]
          },
          "from": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1,
            "maxLength": 4096
          },
          "to": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1,
            "maxLength": 4096
          }
        },
        "required": ["kind", "from", "to"],
        "additionalProperties": false
      }
    },
    "totals": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "nodes": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0,
          "maximum": 9007199254740991
        },
        "edges": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0,
          "maximum": 9007199254740991
        }
      },
      "required": ["nodes", "edges"],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "truncated": {
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "pageInfo": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "endCursor": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1
        },
        "hasNextPage": {
          "type": "boolean"
        }
      },
      "required": ["hasNextPage"],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "clusteredBy": {
      "type": "string",
      "const": "asset"
    },
    "runState": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "draft",
        "preflight",
        "recon",
        "planning",
        "awaiting_gate1",
        "approved",
        "executing",
        "paused",
        "validating",
        "awaiting_gate3",
        "released",
        "reporting",
        "completed",
        "cancelled",
        "killed",
        "failed",
        "expired"
      ]
    }
  },
  "required": ["nodes", "edges", "totals", "truncated", "pageInfo", "clusteredBy", "runState"],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

```json
      "type": "string",
      "enum": ["free", "pro", "enterprise"]

          "type": "integer",

        },

          "type": ["integer", "null"],
          "minimum": 0,
          "description": "The plan limit; null means unlimited."
        }
      }
    },
    "members": {

      "required": ["used", "limit"],
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "used": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0,
          "description": "Current usage of the resource."
        },
        "limit": {
          "type": ["integer", "null"],
          "minimum": 0,
          "description": "The plan limit; null means unlimited."
        }
      }
    },
    "monthlyCostUsd": {
      "type": "object",

        },

          "type": "string",
          "format": "date-time"
        },

          "type": "string",
          "format": "date-time"
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```json
      "default": "UTC",

    },

      "default": "grey",
      "type": "string",
      "enum": ["black", "grey", "white"]

    "defaultNotificationEmail": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "email",
      "pattern": "^(?:[A-Za-z0-9_'+\\-]+\\.)*[A-Za-z0-9_'+\\-]*[A-Za-z0-9_+-]@(?:[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9\\-]*\\.)+[A-Za-z]{2,}$"
    },
    "weekStartsOn": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "number",
          "const": 0
        },
        {
          "type": "number",
          "const": 1
        }
      ]
    },
    "supportContactEmail": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "email",
      "pattern": "^(?:[A-Za-z0-9_'+\\-]+\\.)*[A-Za-z0-9_'+\\-]*[A-Za-z0-9_+-]@(?:[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9\\-]*\\.)+[A-Za-z]{2,}$"
    }
  },
  "required": ["displayTimezone", "defaultAssessmentMode"],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

### TestCaseCreate

| Property          | Type                                                                    | Required | Description |
| ----------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `class`           | enum: `"passive"`, `"active_safe"`, `"state_changing"`, `"destructive"` | yes      |             |
| `title`           | string                                                                  | yes      |             |
| `refs`            | object                                                                  | yes      |             |
| `cweCandidates`   | array of string                                                         | yes      |             |
| `targets`         | array of string                                                         | yes      |             |
| `roles`           | array of string                                                         | yes      |             |
| `budget`          | object                                                                  | yes      |             |
| `oracle`          | object                                                                  | yes      |             |
| `negativeControl` | object or null                                                          | yes      |             |

Full schema:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "class": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": ["passive", "active_safe", "state_changing", "destructive"]
    },
    "title": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 200
    },
    "refs": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "owasp": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^(A(0[1-9]|10)(:2021)?|API(10|[1-9]))$"
          }
        },
        "wstg": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^WSTG-[A-Z]{4}-[0-9]{2}$"
          }
        },
        "asvs": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^(v5\\.0\\.0-)?\\d+\\.\\d+\\.\\d+$"
          }
        }
      },
      "required": ["owasp", "wstg", "asvs"],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "cweCandidates": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "pattern": "^CWE-[1-9][0-9]{0,4}$"
      }
    },
    "targets": {
      "minItems": 1,
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "minLength": 1,
        "maxLength": 2048
      }
    },
    "roles": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "minLength": 1,
        "maxLength": 120
      }
    },
    "budget": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "maxRequests": {
          "type": "integer",
          "exclusiveMinimum": 0,
          "maximum": 10000000
        },
        "maxRps": {
          "type": "number",
          "exclusiveMinimum": 0,
          "maximum": 1000
        },
        "maxConcurrency": {
          "type": "integer",
          "exclusiveMinimum": 0,
          "maximum": 256
        },
        "maxBytes": {
          "type": "integer",
          "exclusiveMinimum": 0,
          "maximum": 1099511627776
        }
      },
      "required": ["maxRequests", "maxRps", "maxConcurrency", "maxBytes"],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "oracle": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "type": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1
        },
        "params": {
          "type": "object",
          "propertyNames": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "additionalProperties": {}
        }
      },
      "required": ["type", "params"],
      "additionalProperties": {}
    },
    "negativeControl": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "object",
          "properties": {
            "kind": {
              "type": "string",
              "enum": [
                "benign_variant",
                "known_safe_endpoint",
                "unauthenticated_baseline",
                "alternate_role"
              ]
            },
            "description": {
              "type": "string",
              "minLength": 1
            },
            "oracleMustNotFire": {
              "type": "boolean",
              "const": true
            },
            "params": {
              "type": "object",
              "propertyNames": {
                "type": "string"
              },
              "additionalProperties": {}
            }
          },
          "required": ["kind", "description", "oracleMustNotFire", "params"],
          "additionalProperties": false
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "class",
    "title",
    "refs",
    "cweCandidates",
    "targets",
    "roles",
    "budget",
    "oracle",
    "negativeControl"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```
